verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's own docs have a dedicated dbt integration page. It names dbt-duckdb as the adapter that lets dbt use DuckDB and MotherDuck, and says the only change needed is the `path:` setting. The homepage also positions running dbt workloads on Standard instances. missing for 10: evidence of deeper dbt docs (incremental models, auth/token config, CI patterns), an indication that the adapter is first-party maintained, and independent or hands-on corroboration of dbt usage.
